facts.F53: Owner: Portfolio (Models/Portfolio.cs) owns the starting value of Default Feature sizing. Its property InfersDefaultFeatureSize starts false, so every new Portfolio starts off wherever it is built: API create, demo data, tests. Existing rows keep their stored value, because the column default and the EF sentinel stay true.
facts.F54: EF mapping: no migration. Mapping stays HasDefaultValue(true).HasSentinel(true). Table, entity value then stored result: absent field gives CLR false, which differs from the sentinel, so EF inserts false (off). Explicit true equals the sentinel, EF omits the column, the DB default true applies (on). Explicit false is inserted false (off). Existing rows and restored old backups hold true and are not touched. Changing the DB column default is rejected: it needs an expand-only migration for every provider and changes no observable outcome.
facts.F55: Create path: the create route stays as it is. PortfolioExtensions keeps the entity value when the DTO bool? is null, so an absent field gives off and a named true or false is kept. The create wizard sends false explicitly (its base settings were true). Clone spreads the source settings, so it keeps the source value. The frontend read fallback stays true: it only meets stored values, or the missing field of an older server, and both mean on.
facts.F56: Demo data: demo Portfolios inherit off from the entity with no factory change. A demo Portfolio gets InfersDefaultFeatureSize = true in DemoDataFactory only where a measured screenshot result needs inferred sizes. The crafter runs each affected @screenshot test alone (--grep one test) and decides per Portfolio. Candidates, by what they show: portfolio detail page, Features page, portfolio metrics widgets, delivery creation, retire-delivery record, delivery timeline, team forecasts. No E2E spec sets or reads the sizing fields, so none relies on them. Changed screenshot content is visible to the maintainer: open finding.
facts.F57: Checker choice: the 6504 Quint model (docs/feature/story-6504-childless-feature-size/model/default-sizing.qnt) is unchanged and not re-run. This feature adds no state, transition or interaction, only a finite starting-value table (absent, true, false, by create, clone, existing). The falsifier is a native NUnit TestCase table over real SQLite EF, because the in-memory EF provider ignores column defaults and sentinels and cannot tell the wrong mapping from the right one. Liveness: not applicable, no temporal behaviour. Agda: no proof obligation. Quint is not used for the table by host direction to stay proportionate; the table claim is DESIGN-checked by the executable table only.
facts.F58: Test port: create has no application service; the controller builds the Portfolio. The lowest layer that proves absent field gives off is Portfolio plus SyncWithPortfolioSettings plus repository Save on real SQLite. The older-client wire concern is covered by extending PortfolioSettingDtoCompatibilityTest (JSON without the field, read as the route reads it, then synced). No web host start is warranted.
facts.F59: Usage event (recommendation, DEVOPS to confirm): keep DefaultFeatureSizingSwitchedOff = 29 unchanged, no rename, no renumber; it still counts people who leave sizing on for an existing Portfolio. If DEVOPS wants to measure opting in on new Portfolios, append a name-only DefaultFeatureSizingSwitchedOn with id 30. No usage-data code in this slice.
